newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRYGG HANSA GETS AVE LAT INSURANCE DEAL - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TRYGG HANSA GETS AVE LAT INSURANCE DEAL - REPORT.

text.p: The Latvian subsidiary of Sweden's Trygg Hansa won a tender to insure the businesses of Ave Lat holding, a food products and finance group, newspaper Bizness i Baltija newspaper said on Friday.
Trygg Hansa Latvia will sign a year-long insurance for the holding company, worth 41,000 lats, covering risks above 50 million lats, the newspaper added.
Ave Lat includes bourse-listed Kaija and Salacgriva 95 fish canneries as well as confectioners Uzvara, Laima, egg producer Balticovo and the Ave Lat Grupa.
The also-rans of the tender were Famlat, Balta and Rigas Fenikss, the newspaper added.
"Ave Lat is a 'growing' client, which might lead to new insurance demands," Janis Abashins, head of Trygg Hansa Latvia was quoted as saying.
